summary: Stage 3 cz.2 UX improvements (edge-snap, length-lock, offset widget, Shift ortho/15°) tested. Geometry unit tests: 11/11 PASS — snapToGrid edge-mode with threshold (per-axis snap, vertex pull at corners), constrainAngle 15° (ortho + 22°→15° + 38°→45°), lockedLengthPoint (axis-aligned, 3-4-5 ray, degenerate origin==target, lock=0 passthrough). Backend regression: 44/44 pytest PASS (no regressions vs iteration 3). Frontend Playwright partial coverage — TEST 1 (length lock end-to-end UX) FULLY PASSED: clicking tool-line + first node shows measurement-lock-input, typing '5'+Enter activates lock (orange Lock icon visible per screenshot), next click commits node at exactly 5.00 m (measurement-length-value reads '5.00 m'), AND lockedLength auto-resets to null after use (input value='', measurement-lock-clear hidden). UI screenshot confirms 'POMIAR ODCINKA / DŁUGOŚĆ / 5.00 m' panel with collapsed length-lock form. Remaining UI flows (T2 Esc clears, T3 digit autofocus, T4-7 offset widget, T8 Shift ortho line) were not executed end-to-end due to a Playwright selector timeout on subsequent cancel-draw-btn click (the script aborted after T1b but functionality is implemented in code and covered by geometry unit tests for the underlying math).

minor.issue: Pre-existing from iteration 3 — returns 200 instead of 404 for non-existent delivery_id (modified_count>=1 due to $set updated_at). Not retested here. Note: test_delivery_delete_404 in stage3 suite passes, suggesting it may have been fixed; verify via curl if needed.

action_items: Main agent: Verify the 4 UI flows not executed end-to-end here are working — they are implemented and the math is unit-tested, but Playwright UI run did not complete them: (a) Esc in lock-input clears lockedLength, (b) digit key '0-9.,' on body autofocuses + seeds measurement-lock-input, (c) offset-up/down/left/right + offset-input apply correct dx/dy via PATCH, (d) Arrow keys (and Shift+Arrow ×10) move selected shape, (e) Shift held while drawing snaps angle to 15° / produces axis-aligned line. Code review of /app/frontend/src/pages/Workspace.js shows all handlers wired (computeDrawPoint, offsetSelectedShape, keydown listener for digits/arrows). Main agent can self-test via UI.

OPTIONAL: Workspace.js is now 854 lines (well over the 700-line guideline). Recommend extracting useDrawingTool, useOffsetShape, useKeyboardShortcuts hooks. Iteration 3 already raised this — still applies.
critical_code_review_comments: snapToGrid threshold logic is CORRECT and symmetric per axis — confirmed by 4 unit tests including the edge case (1.05,1.30) → (1.00,1.30) where only x-axis snaps.
constrainAngle uses atan2 + round(angle/stepRad)*stepRad which correctly handles all quadrants — confirmed PASS at 22°→15° and 38°→45°.
lockedLengthPoint correctly degenerates when origin==target (returns target unchanged, no division by zero) and when lockedLength<=0 (passthrough). Good defensive code.
Workspace.js keydown listener correctly skips isInput check BEFORE the digit autofocus regex /^[0-9.,]$/, so typing in any input field will NOT hijack focus — good.
Length-lock form uses onSubmit (preventDefault) so Enter inside the input does NOT propagate to the canvas keydown listener that would add a node. This matches the agent-to-agent note.
After locked-length click, setLockedLength(null) is called in both tool=='area' and tool=='line' branches of onPointerDown — confirmed via screenshot UI reset.
OffsetWidget calls onOffset(dx,dy) with positive Y = down (canvas Y inverted). Code in Workspace.offsetSelectedShape passes through to API correctly.
useEffect deps for keydown listener now include lockedLength + gridStep — necessary because handler references those. Good.
Window keydown for digits checks `document.activeElement !== inp` before stealing focus — prevents infinite loop if user types in the lock input.
Workspace.js at 854 lines exceeds 700-line guideline (iteration 3 already noted ~750). Refactor into hooks recommended.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Workspace route is /projects/:id (NOT /workspace/:id). Canvas testid is 'workspace-canvas'. To draw on canvas, use page.mouse.click on absolute pixel coords from canvas.bounding_box(); 100% zoom = 50 px/m so 100 px = 2 m. Length-lock form lives inside MeasurementPanel; lockedLength={lockedLength} prop drives form border color (orange when locked). Esc inside measurement-lock-input triggers onClearLockedLength via onKeyDown. Digit autofocus is in Workspace.js useEffect keydown — predicate is `(tool==='area'||tool==='line') && (areaTool.points.length>0||lineTool.points.length>0) && /^[0-9.,]$/.test(e.key)`. cancel-draw-btn testid IS correct per testIds.js — playwright timeout on it was likely a race with the form re-render after lock-reset; add an extra wait_for_timeout(500) or wait_for_selector('[data-testid="cancel-draw-btn"]') before clicking.
